sub_area: domain-based visibility gating of doctypes and roles in permission manager
rationale: Tests the Frappe domain/domainification subsystem (Domain Settings, restrict_to_domain on DocType/Role) which is a pure Python/ORM concern. Ferro has no concept of domain gating and does not reimplement this feature.

sub_area: cascading delete of dynamic-link child records on parent document delete
rationale: Tests that deleting a parent document cascades to dynamically-linked children (Email Unsubscribe, Comments). Ferro's orm.rs implements delete but does not handle dynamic-link cascade cleanup; the behavior is partly in scope as a delete side-effect but the Python-side hook logic is not reimplemented.

sub_area: email queue building, flushing, CC/BCC visibility, unsubscribe URL signing
rationale: Tests the full Frappe email queueing and sending subsystem (frappe.sendmail, Email Queue, flush) which ferro intentionally does not implement; pure Python email processing is outside ferro's scope.

sub_area: HMAC-signed URL round-trip via verified_command helpers
rationale: Tests frappe.utils.verified_command signing/verification helpers in-process only; ferro does not expose or consume these signed URLs in its method surface.

sub_area: live SMTP4Dev integration: actual email delivery and PDF attachment storage
rationale: Requires a running SMTP4Dev service and exercises real email delivery plus PDF generation — neither of which ferro implements or intends to.

sub_area: CSV export of fixture data with various name-filter modes and regex
rationale: Tests frappe's data export (export_csv) fixture utility used during bench migrate/fixture export; this is a dev/deployment tooling concern entirely absent from ferro's runtime surface.

sub_area: JSON fixture export and re-import round-trip for regular and singles doctypes
rationale: Tests export_json/import_doc fixture round-trip in-process; this is data-import/migration tooling that ferro's bench install path handles separately (schema.rs/install.rs) and is not part of the REST runtime under test.

sub_area: date/time/datetime formatting utilities respecting system-wide format defaults
rationale: Pure Python utility tests for frappe.utils date/time formatters; ferro returns raw ISO values from the DB and does not reimplement locale-aware date formatting.

sub_area: monetary number formatting with various number formats and currency precision
rationale: Tests frappe.utils.fmt_money in-process Python formatting logic; ferro returns raw numeric values over the API and does not implement currency formatting.

sub_area: getdoc/getdoctype/get_docinfo Desk form-load APIs including field-level permission masking
rationale: Tests frappe.desk.form.load.getdoc/getdoctype/get_docinfo which ferro reimplements in desk.rs (frappe.desk.form.load.*). The field-level permlevel masking and docinfo aggregation (comments, versions, attachments) are partially covered by ferro's desk path, but docinfo details (versions/tags/comms) may not be fully implemented.

sub_area: frappe.format() for Currency fieldtype with default and doc-level currency
rationale: Tests the Python frappe.format() display formatter for Currency fields in-process; ferro returns raw field values over the API and does not reimplement display formatting.

sub_area: FrappeClient session-auth CRUD (insert/get/update/delete/get_value) and token/Basic auth verification
rationale: Makes real HTTP calls via FrappeClient (password session login) and direct requests with token/Basic auth headers to test CRUD and auth. Token/Basic auth and CRUD are fully in ferro scope (1:1); password session auth is NOT supported by ferro (no sid session store), so the session-based subset fails while the token auth test (test_auth_via_api_key_secret) exercises ferro's core auth.rs path directly.

sub_area: global search index build, FTS queries, web page indexing, and SQL injection prevention
rationale: Tests frappe's __global_search FTS table and related index rebuild/query utilities entirely in-process; ferro does not implement global search functionality.

sub_area: monthly goal graph data aggregation over ORM reads
rationale: Tests frappe.utils.goal chart/aggregation helpers (get_monthly_results/get_monthly_goal_graph_data) used for Desk number-card goals; this is a reporting/charting Python utility not implemented in ferro.
